Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the definition of manager under the civil service law.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the definition of manager under the state civilservice law; and amending RCW 41.06.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.06.022 and 2002 c 354 s 207 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of this chapter, "manager" means any employee who: (1) Formulates statewide policy ((or)) and directs the work of anagency or agency subdivision; (2) Is responsible to administer one or more statewide ((policiesor)) programs of an agency or agency subdivision; or (3) Manages, administers, and controls a local branch office of anagency or agency subdivision, including the direct responsibility andspending authority for at least one percent of the assigned agency'sphysical, financial, or personnel resources((; (4) Has substantial responsibility in personnel administration,legislative relations, public information, or the preparation andadministration of budgets; or (5) Functionally is above the first level of supervision and p. 1 HB 3022exercises authority that is not merely routine or clerical in natureand requires the consistent use of independent judgment)). No employee who is a member of the Washington management servicemay be included in a collective bargaining unit established under RCW41.80.001 and 41.80.010 through 41.80.130.
